dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, crenulated perimeters of approximately 4-5 prominent ring structures on the right flank; gradients transition from low-luminance dark borders to high-luminance interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, non-gradient light pixel clusters scattered between the larger annuli, primarily in the mid-to-lower lateral region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most distinct rings on the right-hand side form a scalene triangle; an additional linear chain of smaller blobs forms an arc toward the upper dorsal ridge.
